title.en: An Act to Appropriate the Sum of Twenty thousand Pesos, Out of Any Funds of the Insular Government Not Otherwise Appropriated, to Be Expended for Public Improvements in the Municipality of Antipolo, Province of Rizal, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
The sum of twenty thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds of the Insular
Government not otherwise appropriated, to be expended for public improvements in the municipality of
Antipolo, Province of Rizal: Provided, however, That any portion of this sum may be applied to the payment
of indebtedness incurred by the municipality of Antipolo, Province of Rizal, for public improvements in that
municipality.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 20, 1921.
